children.title: Connectedness is recognizable
children.statement_en: Connectedness is recognizable from the deck for graphs on at least 3 vertices (Kelly 1957: for n >= 3, G is connected iff at least two cards are connected).

children.title: Kelly's lemma (induced form)
children.statement_en: Kelly's lemma, induced form: if G and H on n vertices are hypomorphic, then for every k < n and every graph F on k vertices, G and H have the same number of k-vertex subsets inducing a copy of F.
children.statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (G.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard = {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (H.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard

children.title: Induced subgraph counts determine component counts of disconnected graphs
children.statement_en: If G and H on n vertices are both disconnected and have the same number of induced copies of every graph on fewer than n vertices, then for every connected graph F they have the same number of connected components isomorphic to F (triangular solve: induced connected copies lie inside one component, all components have fewer than n vertices).
children.statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ¬ G.Connected → ¬ H.Connected → (∀ k : ℕ, k < n → ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (G.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard = {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (H.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), F.Connected → {c : G.ConnectedComponent | Nonempty (G.induce c.supp ≃g F)}.ncard = {c : H.ConnectedComponent | Nonempty (H.induce c.supp ≃g F)}.ncard

children.title: Equal component counts imply isomorphism
children.statement_en: Two graphs on n vertices with the same number of connected components isomorphic to each connected graph F are isomorphic.
children.statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), F.Connected → {c : G.ConnectedComponent | Nonempty (G.induce c.supp ≃g F)}.ncard = {c : H.ConnectedComponent | Nonempty (H.induce c.supp ≃g F)}.ncard) → Nonempty (G ≃g H)
